fact_observations.normalized_fact: The non-secret X-OpenRouter-Metadata: enabled header opts into primary-response router metadata containing requested routing information, strategy, selected provider/model summaries, a one-based successful attempt number, optional attempt details, and optional pipeline stages.
X-OpenRouter-Cache:false disables OpenRouter response caching, cache hits omit openrouter_metadata, and provider prompt caching is a distinct mechanism that may be automatic and affect routing.
